_comment: Bowman Bangers RANK HISTORY. Appended by the Tuesday run (bowman-bangers-tuesday-update) after each reshuffle, and rendered as the per-entry rank-history strip (now/1wk/1mo/3mo) plus the 5-week grid. Pattern borrowed from institutional ranked-list research: one period's move is noise, the same name falling across every horizon is signal. RULES: append only, never rewrite history; a name not ranked in a period gets null (renders as em-dash); dropped names stay in the file so the board can show what left and when.

No reorders. Arquette −13% (biggest fade), Fischer second red week, Kim flat at $131.25 a third week. Crossover watch flagged: Aloy ($62) out-sold Arquette ($50) — week one of two toward a swap.
Board reshuffle: Kim + Florentino promoted from watch tier; Pierce + Aloy demoted.
Watch-tier promotion flags raised (Kim, Florentino, Gonzales, Houston) — not yet acted on.
Fischer promoted to #2 on a +155% re-rate; board order set to match the price ladder.

_departures_comment: Names that LEFT the board, kept permanently. Quietly deleting a former recommendation is how track records get laundered; showing the exit is the honest version. reason: demoted | graduated | aged-out | priced-out. GRADUATION (MLB debut / true RC exists) is the GOOD outcome and must be labelled as such, never as a failure. grade mirrors data/calls.json and is never edited after finalization; null means the name never carried a published verdict.

sizingBands._comment: Suggested position sizing as a % of a card BUDGET, by class — a band, not a number, because a range communicates conviction and uncertainty at once. Guidelines only; size to your own risk tolerance and never size a speculative card like an established one.
